email.subject: Graph is flat — is monitoring broken?
email.body:
The CPU graph is a flat line.

WHAT HAPPENED
I think monitoring is dead because the chart does not move.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO
1. Open CloudWatch, Dashboards, payments-api.
2. Read the note on the flat graph.
3. Check the time range before you call the metric broken.

DO NOT
Do not delete the dashboard or the alarm.

REPLY WITH
Monitoring is not broken. A flat line can be the time range or period. Say what you would widen.

— Rahul

steps.instruction: Check time range / period — often too wide or wrong metric.
Confirm metric namespace/dimension for the instance.

reply.model_reply: Flat graphs are often wrong time range/period or wrong metric dimensions — not dead monitoring. Adjust range and confirm dimensions. — L1

debrief.english: False alarm: range/period before 'monitoring is broken'.
